answer_to_user: Screening European industrials (446-name cohort) for EV/EBITDA BELOW the sector average — the average (cohort_benchmark) came out at ~9.07x, and 80 industrials trade under it. This is genuinely sector-relative, not a fixed cutoff. Cheapest legitimate names near the top include Ernst Russ AG (ERAG.XETRA, ~1.4x), NSC Groupe (ALNSC.PA, ~1.9x), Aumann AG (AAG.XETRA, ~1.9x), Compagnie de l’Odet (ODET.PA, ~2.2x), Norma Group (NOEJ.XETRA, ~2.3x), Fraport (FRA.XETRA, ~2.3x), Air France-KLM (AF.PA, ~2.3x), and FirstGroup (FGP.LSE, ~2.3x) — all well below the ~9x average. CAVEAT: a few of the very cheapest rows (CPPGroup, Active Energy, some pre-revenue names like Vertical Aerospace) have negative or near-zero EBITDA, which produces meaninglessly-low EV/EBITDA — those are data artifacts, not real bargains, and should be screened out. EV/EBITDA is the right multiple here because it neutralizes differing debt loads across industrials.
